page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.l: bus appellare superiores judices placet, à Se-
natu Groningano, temporibus in fœdere
Doccumano expressis, recognoscantur: cæte-
ræ lites aut cum peregrinis, aut peregrino-
rum cum iisdem peregrinis, id est,
iis qui Leoardiæ domicilium non habent, ab
Ho-vetmannis Groningensibus, & conventu
juridico sociorum, ut est in eodem fœdere
Doccumano, definiantur. Dein additum,
ut Groningani præfectum dent Leoardianis,
qui vel in oppido, vel in ejus vicinia com-
modo loco sedem habeat: isque scabini aut
senioris locum teneat in senatu oppidano ea-
que potestate sit, quâ ipse, si adsit, senatus
Groninganus,, cujus vicem geret: eidemque
præfecto Leoardiani stipendium solvant de-
cennio proximo aureos Rhenanos centenos
annuos: interea socii rationem ineant aliam
stipendii ejusdem conficiendi, quæ durèt ad
fœderis usque finem, sintque Leoardiani ab
onere illo centenorum aureorum deinceps li-
beri. Præfectum hunc si quis aufu temera-
rio occidat, prehensus capite pœnas vicissim
pendat, fugâ elapsus omnibus bonis mobi-
libus & immobilibus exuatur, eaque ad
arbitrium senatus in siscum redigantur Gro-
ningensium:

page.notes: The note "Nota A." stands in the left margin, its exact line is uncertain; I placed it at the point where the margin label sits. Small quotation-like marks (,, or ") in the left margin beside several lines and a dash-like mark at the left margin near the bottom of the column are margin marks, not text, and were not transcribed as words. The ",," after "Groninganus" is transcribed as printed. The leading "bus" is a fragment continued from the previous page. Running head and page number are as printed with long s normalised to s.
